2607.03397.title: Efficient bias mitigation in T2I diffusion models using Concept Graphs
2607.03397.paper_summary: Text-to-Image diffusion models often propagate harmful bias inherited from the training data. Existing bias mitigation techniques typically intervene only at the text encoder or provide inference-time guidance, often leading to generations that collapse into semantically incoherent outputs. To address these limitations, we introduce CO-ALIGN (Concept Ontology Alignment), a novel bias mitigation approach based on concept-graph alignment that operates on the model's internal concept ontology. By aligning concepts within the text encoder and denoiser, CO-ALIGN achieves substantial bias reduction while preserving generative integrity. We demonstrate the effectiveness of concept-graph alignment across three paradigms: text-encoders, denoisers and joint text-denoiser ontology alignment. CO-ALIGN outperforms the state of the art, improving fairness by $30\%$, $ΔFID=11.4$ in image quality, $2.8\%$ in image fidelity, all while reducing semantically incoherent outputs by $88\%$. Beyond bias mitigation, we show that CO-ALIGN benefits other downstream tasks as well. In particular, our experiments demonstrate that better-aligned internal ontologies enhance concept unlearning robustness across multiple unlearning techniques.
2607.03397.paper_summary_zh: 文本到圖像的擴散模型往往會傳播從訓練數據中繼承的有害偏見。現有的偏見緩解技術通常僅在文本編碼器上進行干預或提供推理時的指導，這常常導致生成的內容崩潰為語義不連貫的輸出。為了應對這些限制，我們提出了 CO-ALIGN（概念本體對齊），這是一種基於概念圖對齊的新型偏見緩解方法，運作於模型的內部概念本體。通過對齊文本編碼器和去噪器中的概念，CO-ALIGN 實現了顯著的偏見減少，同時保持生成的完整性。我們展示了概念圖對齊在三種範式下的有效性：文本編碼器、去噪器和聯合文本-去噪器本體對齊。CO-ALIGN 超越了當前的最佳技術，公平性提高了 $30\%$，圖像質量改善了 $ΔFID=11.4$，圖像保真度提高了 $2.8\%$，同時語義不連貫的輸出減少了 $88\%$。除了偏見緩解之外，我們還展示了 CO-ALIGN 對其他下游任務的好處。特別是，我們的實驗表明，更好對齊的內部本體增強了多種去學習技術的概念去學習穩健性。
